notes.UK: UK list from the ABPI Code 2024 as read; black triangle only when required.
notes.EU: EU list from Directive 2001/83/EC and the EFPIA Code as read; national codes add more.
notes.CH: Swiss list from the advertising ordinance (AWV) Article 6 as read; the full item list is in references/rules.md.
notes.US: US list is partial: advertisement rules as read; emails and brochures not read.
notes.unknown: Market not given: only company-system elements listed. Ask the market.

data.data_note: Format scan only. Names without a title, villages, jobs and patient stories are not found. A clean scan does not make a text anonymous; the data privacy function decides.
data.small_note: Small-count cutoff {n} is a listing cutoff for reading, not a privacy threshold. Your data privacy function sets that.
